info.name: Balad Gateway APIs/Authentication APIs/Core/Exchange rate API

params.name: serviceId
params.description:
The unique identifier for the service. This parameter specifies the service for which exchange rates are being requested.
1 = Balad Link, 2 = Balad Money, 3 = Balad Bills, 4 = Balad Collection, 5 = Balad VAS

items.docs: The "Get Exchange Rate" API  retrieves the current exchange rates available for a partner based on a specified service.
